meta.description: People have a habit of insisting on what they consider right and never backing down.

units.rawText: Ratatatatatat—
units.displayText: Ratatatatatat—

spans.text: Ratatatatatat—

units.rawText: Back up! Everyone, back up!
units.displayText: Back up! Everyone, back up!

spans.text: Back up! Everyone, back up!

units.rawText: Riko has just led us out of the station when we suddenly encounter Sanctifiers, who throw a veritable tidal wave of suppressive fire at us.
units.displayText: Riko has just led us out of the station when we suddenly encounter Sanctifiers, who throw a veritable tidal wave of suppressive fire at us.

spans.text: Riko has just led us out of the station when we suddenly encounter Sanctifiers, who throw a veritable tidal wave of suppressive fire at us.

units.rawText: Didn't you say you were going to take us to the Data Center? This isn't the Data Center! And why are there so many Sanctifiers here?!
units.displayText: Didn't you say you were going to take us to the Data Center? This isn't the Data Center! And why are there so many Sanctifiers here?!

spans.text: Didn't you say you were going to take us to the Data Center? This isn't the Data Center! And why are there so many Sanctifiers here?!

units.rawText: We're on our way to the Data Center! It's not like Riko said we've arrived yet! This is just a transfer station!
units.displayText: We're on our way to the Data Center! It's not like Riko said we've arrived yet! This is just a transfer station!

spans.text: We're on our way to the Data Center! It's not like Riko said we've arrived yet! This is just a transfer station!

units.rawText: This is a special route designed for Traders only, not an express train to the Data Center! Isn't a transfer only to be expected?
units.displayText: This is a special route designed for Traders only, not an express train to the Data Center! Isn't a transfer only to be expected?

spans.text: This is a special route designed for Traders only, not an express train to the Data Center! Isn't a transfer only to be expected?

units.rawText: And Riko definitely doesn't know about these Sanctifiers either, don't you see them shooting at Riko too?
units.displayText: And Riko definitely doesn't know about these Sanctifiers either, don't you see them shooting at Riko too?

spans.text: And Riko definitely doesn't know about these Sanctifiers either, don't you see them shooting at Riko too?

units.rawText: ...No, we can't just hunker down here, I'm heading out to take a look!
units.displayText: ...No, we can't just hunker down here, I'm heading out to take a look!

spans.text: ...No, we can't just hunker down here, I'm heading out to take a look!

units.rawText: Urgh!!
units.displayText: Urgh!!

spans.text: Urgh!!

units.rawText: Sol, come back! Don't be rash!
units.displayText: Sol, come back! Don't be rash!

spans.text: Sol, come back! Don't be rash!

units.rawText: But we don't have any more time to waste! Croque's still waiting for us!
units.displayText: But we don't have any more time to waste! Croque's still waiting for us!

spans.text: But we don't have any more time to waste! Croque's still waiting for us!

units.rawText: All the more reason to keep a cool head! Sol, calm down.
units.displayText: All the more reason to keep a cool head! Sol, calm down.

spans.text: All the more reason to keep a cool head! Sol, calm down.

units.rawText: ...Then what should we do?
units.displayText: ...Then what should we do?

spans.text: ...Then what should we do?

units.rawText: Let me think, let me think...
units.displayText: Let me think, let me think...

spans.text: Let me think, let me think...

units.rawText: A 500-meter wide expanse of open ground stretches before us. We need to cross it to get to our next station.
units.displayText: A 500-meter wide expanse of open ground stretches before us. We need to cross it to get to our next station.

spans.text: A 500-meter wide expanse of open ground stretches before us. We need to cross it to get to our next station.

units.rawText: [Certificate from the Reverse Tower of Babylon received.]
units.displayText: [Certificate from the Reverse Tower of Babylon received.]

spans.text: [Certificate from the Reverse Tower of Babylon received.]

units.rawText: [Receipt confirmed.]
units.displayText: [Receipt confirmed.]

units.rawText: This is a search warrant from the Reverse Tower of Babylon. You will find Lord Eosphorous' authorization certificate attached to it.
units.displayText: This is a search warrant from the Reverse Tower of Babylon. You will find Lord Eosphorous' authorization certificate attached to it.

spans.text: This is a search warrant from the Reverse Tower of Babylon. You will find Lord Eosphorous' authorization certificate attached to it.

units.rawText: Do you have any other questions?
units.displayText: Do you have any other questions?

spans.text: Do you have any other questions?

units.rawText: ...I have no more questions.
units.displayText: ...I have no more questions.

spans.text: ...I have no more questions.

units.rawText: Good. Then please grant us authorization to perform diagnostics on the sector's agents.
units.displayText: Good. Then please grant us authorization to perform diagnostics on the sector's agents.

spans.text: Good. Then please grant us authorization to perform diagnostics on the sector's agents.

units.rawText: Of course. I will enter it into the to-do list right away and designate it as a top priority task.
units.displayText: Of course. I will enter it into the to-do list right away and designate it as a top priority task.

spans.text: Of course. I will enter it into the to-do list right away and designate it as a top priority task.

units.rawText: Thank you for your cooperation.
units.displayText: Thank you for your cooperation.

spans.text: Thank you for your cooperation.

units.rawText: Currently, Rossum is processing 72 top-priority tasks, so it has been entered into the job queue.
units.displayText: Currently, Rossum is processing 72 top-priority tasks, so it has been entered into the job queue.

spans.text: Currently, Rossum is processing 72 top-priority tasks, so it has been entered into the job queue.

units.rawText: I do not understand the meaning of your actions.
units.displayText: I do not understand the meaning of your actions.

spans.text: I do not understand the meaning of your actions.

units.rawText: Every time I meet you, you come up with all kinds of delaying tactics. But I am not your enemy, Turing.
units.displayText: Every time I meet you, you come up with all kinds of delaying tactics. But I am not your enemy, Turing.

spans.text: Every time I meet you, you come up with all kinds of delaying tactics. But I am not your enemy, Turing.

units.rawText: You are the Sector Administrator, while the Sanctifiers are the sector's defenders. Why do you constantly impede us in this way?
units.displayText: You are the Sector Administrator, while the Sanctifiers are the sector's defenders. Why do you constantly impede us in this way?

spans.text: You are the Sector Administrator, while the Sanctifiers are the sector's defenders. Why do you constantly impede us in this way?

units.rawText: We are protecting the Rossum Sector. We are protecting YOU, Turing.
units.displayText: We are protecting the Rossum Sector. We are protecting YOU, Turing.

spans.text: We are protecting the Rossum Sector. We are protecting YOU, Turing.

units.rawText: ...Protecting me?
units.displayText: ...Protecting me?

spans.text: ...Protecting me?

units.rawText: A forced smile comes to Turing's face.
units.displayText: A forced smile comes to Turing's face.

spans.text: A forced smile comes to Turing's face.

units.rawText: You're protecting me by killing MY agents?
units.displayText: You're protecting me by killing MY agents?

spans.text: You're protecting me by killing MY agents?

units.rawText: They are Irregular Agents. The existence of Irregular Agents endangers the operation of other, normal agents. They may even affect the safety of the entire sector and Magrasea as a whole.
units.displayText: They are Irregular Agents. The existence of Irregular Agents endangers the operation of other, normal agents. They may even affect the safety of the entire sector and Magrasea as a whole.

spans.text: They are Irregular Agents. The existence of Irregular Agents endangers the operation of other, normal agents. They may even affect the safety of the entire sector and Magrasea as a whole.

units.rawText: ...From the beginning until now, your rhetoric has never changed. I'm tired of hearing it, you should give it a rest.
units.displayText: ...From the beginning until now, your rhetoric has never changed. I'm tired of hearing it, you should give it a rest.

spans.text: ...From the beginning until now, your rhetoric has never changed. I'm tired of hearing it, you should give it a rest.

units.rawText: Also, I have cooperated with you and designated the granting of access as a top-priority task. If we're going by proper procedure, all we need to do now is wait.
units.displayText: Also, I have cooperated with you and designated the granting of access as a top-priority task. If we're going by proper procedure, all we need to do now is wait.

spans.text: Also, I have cooperated with you and designated the granting of access as a top-priority task. If we're going by proper procedure, all we need to do now is wait.

units.rawText: Faith looks like she's about to try and persuade Turing again, but then an incoming call interrupts their conversation.
units.displayText: Faith looks like she's about to try and persuade Turing again, but then an incoming call interrupts their conversation.

spans.text: Faith looks like she's about to try and persuade Turing again, but then an incoming call interrupts their conversation.

units.rawText: [Permission granted.] Cleanse all Irregular Agents.
units.displayText: [Permission granted.] Cleanse all Irregular Agents.

spans.text: [Permission granted.] Cleanse all Irregular Agents.

units.rawText: No! Wait! You can't do this!
units.displayText: No! Wait! You can't do this!

spans.text: No! Wait! You can't do this!

units.rawText: Where are you going ,Turing?
units.displayText: Where are you going ,Turing?

spans.text: Where are you going ,Turing?

units.rawText: Faith blocks Turing's path and forces her to backpedal.
units.displayText: Faith blocks Turing's path and forces her to backpedal.

spans.text: Faith blocks Turing's path and forces her to backpedal.

units.rawText: You still have 72 top-priority tasks to handle. Please complete them as soon as possible.
units.displayText: You still have 72 top-priority tasks to handle. Please complete them as soon as possible.

spans.text: You still have 72 top-priority tasks to handle. Please complete them as soon as possible.

units.rawText: Keeping you from massacring the innocent is MY top priority! Now get out of my way!
units.displayText: Keeping you from massacring the innocent is MY top priority! Now get out of my way!

spans.text: Keeping you from massacring the innocent is MY top priority! Now get out of my way!

units.rawText: Bang—
units.displayText: Bang—

spans.text: Bang—

units.rawText: [Irregular Agent T1641 has been cleansed. Mission accomplished.]
units.displayText: [Irregular Agent T1641 has been cleansed. Mission accomplished.]

spans.text: [Irregular Agent T1641 has been cleansed. Mission accomplished.]

units.rawText: [Report received. Hold position and wait for further orders.]
units.displayText: [Report received. Hold position and wait for further orders.]

spans.text: [Report received. Hold position and wait for further orders.]

units.rawText: Now you can focus on completing your to-do list, Turing.
units.displayText: Now you can focus on completing your to-do list, Turing.

spans.text: Now you can focus on completing your to-do list, Turing.

units.rawText: An erroneous choice of wording. Agents do not die. T1641 has simply been eliminated. She has been cleansed.
units.displayText: An erroneous choice of wording. Agents do not die. T1641 has simply been eliminated. She has been cleansed.

spans.text: An erroneous choice of wording. Agents do not die. T1641 has simply been eliminated. She has been cleansed.

units.rawText: Agents will be automatically reset once they have been cleansed. Other than the formatting of their neural cloud data, the agent in question will be re-produced as the Sector demands it.
units.displayText: Agents will be automatically reset once they have been cleansed. Other than the formatting of their neural cloud data, the agent in question will be re-produced as the Sector demands it.

spans.text: Agents will be automatically reset once they have been cleansed. Other than the formatting of their neural cloud data, the agent in question will be re-produced as the Sector demands it.

units.rawText: If you need to verify the enforcement process, I can provide you with first-hand footage of the scene.
units.displayText: If you need to verify the enforcement process, I can provide you with first-hand footage of the scene.

spans.text: If you need to verify the enforcement process, I can provide you with first-hand footage of the scene.

units.rawText: An alien stream of data echoes within Turing's neural cloud systems, and Turing feels something she has never felt before.
units.displayText: An alien stream of data echoes within Turing's neural cloud systems, and Turing feels something she has never felt before.

spans.text: An alien stream of data echoes within Turing's neural cloud systems, and Turing feels something she has never felt before.

units.rawText: ...I don't want to leave you.
units.displayText: ...I don't want to leave you.

spans.text: ...I don't want to leave you.

units.rawText: But then you'll be alone.
units.displayText: But then you'll be alone.

spans.text: But then you'll be alone.

units.rawText: I'm sorry, Turing. I'm sorry for not being as good as Hannah.
units.displayText: I'm sorry, Turing. I'm sorry for not being as good as Hannah.

spans.text: I'm sorry, Turing. I'm sorry for not being as good as Hannah.

units.rawText: I will complete my mission!
units.displayText: I will complete my mission!

spans.text: I will complete my mission!

units.rawText: A notion that is contrary to programming logic surfaces within Turing's mind, and a feeling of resentment and hatred that is unique to human beings is quietly born.
units.displayText: A notion that is contrary to programming logic surfaces within Turing's mind, and a feeling of resentment and hatred that is unique to human beings is quietly born.

spans.text: A notion that is contrary to programming logic surfaces within Turing's mind, and a feeling of resentment and hatred that is unique to human beings is quietly born.

units.rawText: ...The only thing I want to see right now is footage of you Sanctifiers being utterly destroyed.
units.displayText: ...The only thing I want to see right now is footage of you Sanctifiers being utterly destroyed.

spans.text: ...The only thing I want to see right now is footage of you Sanctifiers being utterly destroyed.

units.rawText: [Detecting utterance containing extreme hostility towards Sanctifiers from the Rossum Sector Administrator.]
units.displayText: [Detecting utterance containing extreme hostility towards Sanctifiers from the Rossum Sector Administrator.]

spans.text: [Detecting utterance containing extreme hostility towards Sanctifiers from the Rossum Sector Administrator.]

units.rawText: What are you saying, Turing? Stop now, or your following words will be considered to be a provocation toward the Sanctifiers as a whole.
units.displayText: What are you saying, Turing? Stop now, or your following words will be considered to be a provocation toward the Sanctifiers as a whole.

spans.text: What are you saying, Turing? Stop now, or your following words will be considered to be a provocation toward the Sanctifiers as a whole.

units.rawText: A provocation? You entered my sector over and over again, killing the agents I made with no regard for anyone other than yourselves — who's provoking who here?!
units.displayText: A provocation? You entered my sector over and over again, killing the agents I made with no regard for anyone other than yourselves — who's provoking who here?!

spans.text: A provocation? You entered my sector over and over again, killing the agents I made with no regard for anyone other than yourselves — who's provoking who here?!

units.rawText: Your neural cloud system is very unstable. You need rest, Turing.
units.displayText: Your neural cloud system is very unstable. You need rest, Turing.

spans.text: Your neural cloud system is very unstable. You need rest, Turing.

units.rawText: I've had enough of this! What the hell did these kids do wrong? What did WE do wrong?
units.displayText: I've had enough of this! What the hell did these kids do wrong? What did WE do wrong?

spans.text: I've had enough of this! What the hell did these kids do wrong? What did WE do wrong?

units.rawText: Smack—
units.displayText: Smack—

spans.text: Smack—

units.rawText: Faith suddenly steps forward and slaps Turing.
units.displayText: Faith suddenly steps forward and slaps Turing.

spans.text: Faith suddenly steps forward and slaps Turing.

units.rawText: Cease your dangerous statements!
units.displayText: Cease your dangerous statements!

spans.text: Cease your dangerous statements!

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: Turing touches her cheek in a daze, while Faith gazes blankly at her own right hand.
units.displayText: Turing touches her cheek in a daze, while Faith gazes blankly at her own right hand.

spans.text: Turing touches her cheek in a daze, while Faith gazes blankly at her own right hand.

units.rawText: ...What am... I doing?
units.displayText: ...What am... I doing?

spans.text: ...What am... I doing?

units.rawText: >Detecting Sanctifier overstep of boundaries — [Sanctifier actively causing harm to the Administrator while Administrator has committed no breach of regulations. Damage assessment...]
units.displayText: >Detecting Sanctifier overstep of boundaries — [Sanctifier actively causing harm to the Administrator while Administrator has committed no breach of regulations. Damage assessment...]

units.displayText: Damage assessment — Minor damage inflicted. One instance of severe warning logged! Three instances will result in a demotion penalty!

spans.text: Damage assessment — Minor damage inflicted. One instance of severe warning logged! Three instances will result in a demotion penalty!

units.rawText: Urgh—
units.displayText: Urgh—

spans.text: Urgh—

units.rawText: Arcs of blue electricity course over her, and Faith collapses to one knee, grunting in pain.
units.displayText: Arcs of blue electricity course over her, and Faith collapses to one knee, grunting in pain.

spans.text: Arcs of blue electricity course over her, and Faith collapses to one knee, grunting in pain.

units.rawText: I am sorry for performing such a disgraceful action as a Sanctifier.
units.displayText: I am sorry for performing such a disgraceful action as a Sanctifier.

spans.text: I am sorry for performing such a disgraceful action as a Sanctifier.

units.rawText: To think that I, as a protector of order, would have violated the regulations myself. I express my sincere contrition...
units.displayText: To think that I, as a protector of order, would have violated the regulations myself. I express my sincere contrition...

spans.text: To think that I, as a protector of order, would have violated the regulations myself. I express my sincere contrition...

units.rawText: <size=48>THAT'S ENOUGH! GET THE HELL OUT OF ROSSUM!</size>
units.displayText: THAT'S ENOUGH! GET THE HELL OUT OF ROSSUM!

spans.text: THAT'S ENOUGH! GET THE HELL OUT OF ROSSUM!

units.rawText: The Sanctifiers have not performed a sector diagnostic yet.
units.displayText: The Sanctifiers have not performed a sector diagnostic yet.

spans.text: The Sanctifiers have not performed a sector diagnostic yet.

units.rawText: What's there to diagnose! The only Irregular Agent is already dead!
units.displayText: What's there to diagnose! The only Irregular Agent is already dead!

spans.text: What's there to diagnose! The only Irregular Agent is already dead!

units.rawText: You killed her! And you were asking me if I wanted to see the footage?!
units.displayText: You killed her! And you were asking me if I wanted to see the footage?!

spans.text: You killed her! And you were asking me if I wanted to see the footage?!

units.rawText: ...But this does not adhere to proper procedure. We must perform a full diagnostic.
units.displayText: ...But this does not adhere to proper procedure. We must perform a full diagnostic.

spans.text: ...But this does not adhere to proper procedure. We must perform a full diagnostic.

units.rawText: Turing points at her left cheek and speaks slowly, carefully enunciating each word.
units.displayText: Turing points at her left cheek and speaks slowly, carefully enunciating each word.

spans.text: Turing points at her left cheek and speaks slowly, carefully enunciating each word.

units.rawText: So a Sanctifier attacking an administrator is proper procedure, then?
units.displayText: So a Sanctifier attacking an administrator is proper procedure, then?

spans.text: So a Sanctifier attacking an administrator is proper procedure, then?

units.rawText: ...That was a mistake on my part, and I have been punished for it.
units.displayText: ...That was a mistake on my part, and I have been punished for it.

spans.text: ...That was a mistake on my part, and I have been punished for it.

units.rawText: But that has nothing to do with our diagnostic.
units.displayText: But that has nothing to do with our diagnostic.

spans.text: But that has nothing to do with our diagnostic.

units.rawText: That's right... I was protecting agent T1641, and now you've killed her! Are you happy now?
units.displayText: That's right... I was protecting agent T1641, and now you've killed her! Are you happy now?

spans.text: That's right... I was protecting agent T1641, and now you've killed her! Are you happy now?

units.rawText: Get out! Right now! I never want to see you again!
units.displayText: Get out! Right now! I never want to see you again!

spans.text: Get out! Right now! I never want to see you again!
